working: Radial nodes are where Ψ crosses zero at r > 0. A (1s) never crosses, so it has 0 nodes. B (2s) crosses once, so 1 node. C (3s) goes positive, then negative, then positive, crossing zero twice, so 2 nodes. D (3p) starts at zero at r = 0, which is not a radial node, then crosses once, so 1 node. Only C has two radial nodes.
